LanguageData.LP_BD_Inspired.label: bardic inspiration
LanguageData.LP_BD_Inspired.description: The bard's song echoes in the heart: melee hit, shooting accuracy and work speed increased (more with stronger inspiration), mental break threshold -5%.
LanguageData.LP_BD_ValorInspired.label: combat inspiration
LanguageData.LP_BD_ValorInspired.description: College of Valor war song: damage taken ×0.9, melee damage ×1.15. Fades together with Bardic Inspiration.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Mocked.label: shaken
LanguageData.LP_BD_Mocked.description: Stung by sharp words and rattled: melee hit -20%, lower shooting accuracy.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Laughing.label: hideous laughter
LanguageData.LP_BD_Laughing.description: Can't stop laughing, collapsed on the ground unable to move. Snaps out at once when damaged.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Resting.label: song of rest
LanguageData.LP_BD_Resting.description: The bard sang lullabies all night: sleep recovery ×1.3, faster wound healing (faster the stronger).
LanguageData.LP_BD_Resting.stages._15.label: ×1.5 healing
LanguageData.LP_BD_Resting.stages._175.label: ×1.75 healing
LanguageData.LP_BD_Resting.stages._2.label: ×2 healing
LanguageData.LP_BD_Resting.stages._225.label: ×2.25 healing
LanguageData.LP_BD_Resting.stages._25.label: ×2.5 healing
LanguageData.LP_BD_JackPassive.label: jack of all trades
LanguageData.LP_BD_JackPassive.description: Knows a bit of everything: all skills +2 levels, learning speed +15%.
LanguageData.LP_BD_Countercharmed.label: countercharm
LanguageData.LP_BD_Countercharmed.description: The bard's melody keeps echoing in the heart: mind resistance +30%, psychic sensitivity -30% (bad moods from psychic shocks are lessened accordingly).
LanguageData.LP_BD_Confused.label: confused
LanguageData.LP_BD_Confused.description: Mind in a tangle: every 2 seconds randomly zones out, wanders, or attacks anyone nearby.
LanguageData.LP_BD_CuttingWords.label: cutting words
LanguageData.LP_BD_CuttingWords.description: Mocked into shame by a College of Lore bard: melee hit -25%, lower shooting accuracy, damage dealt ×0.75.
LanguageData.LP_BD_LorePassive.label: erudition
LanguageData.LP_BD_LorePassive.description: College of Lore learning: research speed increased (faster the stronger).
LanguageData.LP_BD_PeerlessPassive.label: peerless skill
LanguageData.LP_BD_PeerlessPassive.description: Master of the College of Lore: social impact and negotiation ability +15%, surgery success +10%; crafted items have a 30% chance of +1 quality tier.
LanguageData.LP_BD_ValorPassive.label: College of Valor
LanguageData.LP_BD_ValorPassive.description: Skill at arms of a war singer: Shooting and Melee +3 levels.
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraAttackPassive.label: extra attack
LanguageData.LP_BD_ExtraAttackPassive.description: Faster strikes: melee attack cooldown ×0.8, aiming time ×0.8.
LanguageData.LP_BD_BattleMagicBuff.label: battle magic
LanguageData.LP_BD_BattleMagicBuff.description: The afterglow of casting lingers on the fingertips: the next attack needs almost no aiming, comes out faster and deals ×1.25 damage (gone after one hit).
LanguageData.LP_BD_Anthem.label: rallying war cry
LanguageData.LP_BD_Anthem.description: A war song that sets the blood racing: pain ×0.5, movement ×1.2, mind resistance +50%.
LanguageData.LP_BD_BladePassive.label: blade flourish
LanguageData.LP_BD_BladePassive.description: College of Swords footwork: movement ×1.15; melee hits trigger flourishes of the current style.
LanguageData.LP_BD_SilverPassive.label: silver tongue
LanguageData.LP_BD_SilverPassive.description: College of Eloquence speech: negotiation ability ×1.5 (easier recruiting and persuasion), trade prices +10%, social impact +20%.
LanguageData.LP_BD_FinalSong.label: song of the finale
LanguageData.LP_BD_FinalSong.description: The last verse of the epic: no mental breaks, higher hit chance, pain ×0.5; if downed during it, half the injuries heal at once and you try to stand up once.
LanguageData.LP_BD_FinaleAura.label: singing the finale
LanguageData.LP_BD_FinaleAura.description: Singing the song of the finale: enemies within 30 cells have a 25% chance every 5 seconds to flee in fear (mechanoids unaffected).
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Dancing.label: irresistible dance
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Dancing.description: The body won't stop dancing: cannot attack or walk away, damage taken ×1.3.
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Foresight.label: foresight
LanguageData.LP_ACB_Foresight.description: Sees a moment into the future: melee hit +25%, better shooting accuracy, melee dodge +25%, mind resistance +50%, cannot be ambushed.
